data.title: Invoice RE-2026-0142 from Muster Möbelwerkstatt GmbH
data.summary: Muster Möbelwerkstatt GmbH invoiced David Muster €1,487.50 (invoice RE-2026-0142, dated 30.01.2026) for building and installing a built-in shelf (Einbauregal), including €380.00 for on-site assembly labour. Payment is due within one month of the invoice date.
data.explanation: This is a craftsman's invoice for custom furniture work at your home. Please transfer the total amount (€1,487.50) to the IBAN shown by the deadline shown, referencing the invoice number. Keep this invoice: the labour/assembly cost (€380.00) may qualify for the German tax deduction for craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen, §35a EStG), so include it in your tax return. If you dispute the work or the amount, contact the company directly before the payment deadline.

items.title: Pay invoice RE-2026-0142
items.action: Transfer the invoice amount to Muster Möbelwerkstatt GmbH's bank account.
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Rechnungsbetrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug auf unser Konto (IBAN siehe unten).

data.tax_note: The itemized on-site assembly labour cost (€380.00 of €1,487.50) may be deductible as a household craftsman service (Handwerkerleistung, §35a EStG) in the German tax return; keep this invoice and proof of bank transfer.
